describe: The image shows a machine gun seen from the side: a dark blue-black body with a perforated barrel shroud on the left, a bulky receiver with panels in the centre, and a warm brown grip at the lower right. Three small round gem-like lights (red, blue and dark) sit along the top, and a small dark panel with an ammunition readout sits lower left. Lit from the upper left, the metal is mostly dark with a few grey highlights, set against a dark olive-yellow background with a yellow outline along the gun.
